declared_by: the student (your-input). Every rule below is a declared choice, not a fact: edit it to change what counts as ML/AI and as senior, and every value it produces changes label with it.

tiers.proven_min_approvals_reason: 10 is the median approval count among the 1,557 companies with an H-1B record (data/80-days-to-stay/data/SEC_DOL_H1b_data_mapped-join-validation-audit.md). Below it, one or two approvals are too thin to call Proven.
tiers.p_reason: 0.9 and 0.6 are the Proven and Likely sponsorship values in the Chapter 11 worked example (data/examples/ch11-roles.json). They are adopted here as a declared mapping, not derived from this data.

liveness.max_age_reason: A liveness check describes one moment. A week-old 'active' is treated as unchecked.

source.pin_reason: The audit records this SHA-256 for the same file. If the file changes, the audits no longer describe it and the source gate stops the run.
